description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Quick Poison (15s)] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Attach Poison 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Ultros] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Ultros
description.text: Increases [Poison Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.0 for PHY attacks and BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Ultros after using three Poison abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Ultros
description.text: One single attack (5.34 or 14.52) capped at 99999, 6.00 or 16.40 if exploiting Poison weakness

description.name: Attach Poison 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
